title: Prove real multi-country national regional and local retrieval
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
retrieval-evaluation.json files are untracked relative to site_revision. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of an ordinary git status. Its own sha256 is not stored inside this file.
Eight cited passages from official HTTPS responses were indexed. The index is not a full code, not every article on a fetched page, and not a pinned dataset payload.
Labelled recall at 5 is 1 for each supported judgment after jurisdiction exclusion. That is passage recall on this index. It is not worldwide corpus recall and it is not cross-language recall.

Latin queries used searchCompactPostings. Arabic used the production arabic tokenizer and Japanese used cjk-unigram, with the same BM25 contribution. The pinned FTS5 reader returned no query terms for those two queries, and its recall is 0.

Shared-token probes are filter checks, not citation judgments. On artikel, Bayern outranked Noord-Holland before the filter. On ist, the federal Grundgesetz outranked Bayern before the filter. Exclusion removed those jurisdictions.
No judgment decides that an instrument binds a person, act, or dispute.

The German page is headed Nichtamtliches Inhaltsverzeichnis. The Bavarian page did not contain the word amtlich. Response SHA-256 values are retrieved HTTP bodies, not publisher revisions. No redistribution license was read.

Aswan municipal coverage is unsupported. The presidency PDF is a national constitution file, and the pinned dispositions have no Egypt municipal row. Brazil municipal laws, United Kingdom county laws, the common-crawl municipal index, and the municipal code-only scraper release stay explicit gaps.
The audit checks the fixture contract only. It does not fetch the cited URLs again and it does not re-score the index. stderr was empty.
